10 /**
11  * CLI runner (importable for tests).
12  * @param {string[]} argv
13  * @param {{ write?: (s: string) => void, exit?: (code: number) => void }} [io]
14  */
15 export function runCli(argv, io = {}) {
16   const write = io.write ?? ((s) => process.stdout.write(s));
17   const exit = io.exit ?? ((code) => process.exit(code));
18   const result = main(argv);
19   const exitCode = result && result.ok === true ? 0 : 1;
20   write(`${JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}\n`);
21   exit(exitCode);
22   return { result, exitCode };
23 }
